info.title: NelcotaCloud API
info.description: Multitenant Auth: every request names its tenant with an API key.

201.description: Tenant created; its API keys are shown only here

400.description: Invalid slug, name or site URL

delete.summary: `DELETE /admin/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}`: deletes the tenant, its users and its database.

get.summary:
`GET /admin/api-keys`: active keys and the first page of revoked keys, newest first.
Pass the response cursor as `before` for the next page of revoked keys.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Cursor for the next page of revoked keys

X-Nelcota-Next-Cursor.description: Cursor when more revoked keys exist

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

post.summary:
`POST /admin/api-keys`: a new key next to the existing ones, so apps can switch to it
before the old one is revoked. The key is shown only in this response.

201.description: Key created; store it now, it is not shown again

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

409.description: The project already holds the most active keys allowed

delete.summary: `DELETE /admin/api-keys/{key_id}`: the key stops working at once.

parameters.name: key_id
parameters.description: Id of the key to revoke

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

404.description: No active key with this id

409.description: It is the last active secret key

get.summary: `GET /admin/audit-events`: the project's activity log, newest first, kept for 90 days.
get.description: Optionally narrowed to one kind of event and searched by email or IP address.

schema.description: Narrows the activity log to one kind of event.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Part of the email or IP address to search for.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Only events of the last this many days. The log keeps 90.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Only events at or after this instant (RFC 3339). Pass with `to`, instead of `days`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Only events before this instant (RFC 3339), at most 92 days after `from`.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Only events older than this id (the previous page's `next_before`).

400.description: Invalid user, kind, search, period, cursor or limit

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

get.summary: `GET /admin/audit-events/export`: streams the matching events as a CSV file, newest first.
get.description: Takes the same filters as the activity log, so the file holds what the console shows.

schema.description: Narrows the activity log to one kind of event.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Part of the email or IP address to search for.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Only events of the last this many days. The log keeps 90.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Only events at or after this instant (RFC 3339). Pass with `to`, instead of `days`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Only events before this instant (RFC 3339), at most 92 days after `from`.

400.description: Invalid user, kind, search or period

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

get.summary: `GET /admin/audit-events/summary`: counts and the most refused IP addresses over a period.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description:
How many days back from now. The activity log keeps 90 days. Without a period, the
last 7 days.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Only events at or after this instant (RFC 3339). Pass with `to`, instead of `days`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Only events before this instant (RFC 3339), at most 92 days after `from`.

400.description: Days outside 1 to 90, or an invalid range

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

get.summary:
`GET /admin/blocked-addresses`: the addresses and ranges refused by the public auth routes,
newest first. Expired blocks are left out.

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

post.summary:
`POST /admin/blocked-addresses`: refuses logins, signups and emailed links from the address.
Blocking a listed range again replaces its note and expiry.

400.description: Not an address, or a range wider than /16 (/48 for IPv6)

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

400.description: Invalid keys, or a secret Cloudflare does not know

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

delete.summary: `DELETE /admin/captcha`: logins and signups no longer need a captcha.

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

get.summary: `GET /admin/email-templates`: the wording of each auth email, the project's or the default.

`DELETE /admin/logo`: the project goes back to its mascot or initials; succeeds when there

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

put.summary: Replace the project's registered app callback URLs.

put.summary: `PUT /admin/oauth/{provider}`: the tenant registers its own OAuth app (secret key only).

get.summary: `GET /admin/settings` (secret key only).

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

patch.summary: Changes only the fields that are sent for the resolved project.

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

post.summary:
`POST /admin/signing-keys/rotate`: a new key signs from now on; tokens signed by the
previous key keep verifying until they expire.

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

409.description: Too many rotations within a day

get.summary: `GET /admin/smtp`: where the tenant's auth emails are sent from, without credentials.

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

put.summary: `PUT /admin/smtp`: auth emails of the tenant go through its own SMTP server.
put.description:
The server must be on a public host and an SMTP port, so the API cannot be used to reach
services inside its own network.

400.description: Invalid URL or sender, or a private host or port

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

delete.summary: `DELETE /admin/smtp`: auth emails go through the platform's SMTP server again.

204.description: Back to the platform's SMTP server

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

post.summary: `POST /admin/smtp/test`: sends a test email through the tenant's own SMTP server.
post.description:
Waits for the server to accept the message, so the owner sees a delivery problem right
away. Either the saved server or, with `server`, settings about to be saved (checked by the
same host policy), so a wrong password is caught before auth emails depend on it. Never the
platform's server: it is not offered as a free relay.

204.description: The SMTP server accepted the test email

400.description: Invalid recipient, or invalid unsaved settings

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

409.description: The project uses the platform's SMTP server

502.description: The SMTP server refused or could not be reached

get.summary: `GET /admin/usage`: active users this month and last month.

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Allow a cached snapshot up to 30 seconds old.

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

get.summary: `GET /admin/usage/daily`: logins and sign-ups per UTC day, for the console's chart.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: How many days, ending today (UTC). The activity log keeps logins for 90 days.

200.description: One entry per day, oldest first

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

parameters.name: order

get.summary: Lists users newest first, or by most recent login, using a continuation cursor.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Part of the email to search for.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only users in this state; every user without it.

schema.description: The order of the admin user list.

200.description: One page of users without a total count

400.description: Invalid search, status, order, limit or cursor

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

post.summary: `POST /admin/users/{user_id}/unban`: the user can log in again.

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

post.summary:
`POST /admin/users/{user_id}/verification-email`: emails a new verification link to an
unverified user, under the same per-address limit as the public resend.

202.description: A new verification link is being sent

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project; or the user is banned

get.summary: `GET /admin/webhooks`: the project's webhook endpoints, oldest first.

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

post.summary: `POST /admin/webhooks`: a new endpoint and its signing secret, shown only in this answer.

201.description: Endpoint created; store its secret now

400.description: Invalid or private URL, or no event types

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

200.description: Delivery queue health for the authorized project

403.description: Project access denied

429.description: Too many queue reads for this project

get.summary: `GET /captcha`: for apps, whether to render the Turnstile widget and with which site key.

200.description: The site key, or `null` when no captcha is needed

get.summary:
Public keys of the tenant, so other services can verify access tokens without calling us.
The document is serialized once per key set and shared by every response.

200.description: The tenant's public keys (JWKS) to verify access tokens

post.summary: `POST /login`: email and password.

200.description: Logged in, or the MFA step that must come first

403.description: Email not verified yet

post.summary: Always answers 204, even for unknown tokens, so the endpoint cannot be used to probe tokens.

`POST /magic-link`: emails a one-time login link. A new user account is created when
the recipient opens the link; the answer is the same for every address.
`POST /magic-link/verify`: trades the token from the emailed link for a session.
post.description:
Opening the link proves control of the inbox. On an account nobody verified, whoever set
its password may not own the email, so its password, sessions and authenticator go.

200.description: Logged in, or the MFA step that must come first

403.description: The user is banned

get.summary: `GET /mfa`: the second factors of the logged-in user.

post.summary:
`POST /mfa/challenge`: the second step of a login with MFA on. Each challenge allows a few
wrong codes; after that the login starts over.

400.description: Unknown, expired or exhausted MFA token

post.summary: `POST /mfa/totp`: starts adding a TOTP authenticator (replacing a pending one). Shown once.

201.description: Authenticator created; verify it with a first code

delete.summary:
`DELETE /mfa/totp`: turns TOTP off. A current code is required, so a stolen access token
alone cannot remove the second factor.

401.description: Wrong code or invalid access token

post.summary: `POST /mfa/totp/verify`: the first code turns the pending authenticator on.

204.description: TOTP enabled; logins now ask for a code

401.description: Wrong code or invalid access token

get.summary: `GET /oauth/callback`: the provider sends the browser here.
get.description:
On success the browser goes back to the app with a short-lived `code` (exchanged at
`POST /oauth/token` with the app's PKCE verifier), never with tokens in the URL; on
failure, with an `error` code.

303.description: Redirects back to the app with a one-time `code`, or an `error`

post.summary:
`POST /oauth/token`: trades the one-time code from the OAuth redirect for a session. The
code is consumed even when the verifier is wrong, so it cannot be guessed against.

200.description: Logged in, or the MFA step that must come first

401.description: Invalid or expired code, or wrong code verifier

get.summary: `GET /oauth/{provider}/authorize`: redirects the browser to the provider's sign-in page.

parameters.name: apikey
parameters.description: The publishable key travels in the query: this endpoint is opened by a browser redirect.

parameters.name: code_challenge_method
parameters.description: Only S256 is supported; it may be omitted.

303.description: Redirects the browser to the provider's sign-in page

400.description: Invalid redirect, PKCE challenge or provider not configured

post.summary: `POST /recover`: emails a password reset link.

202.description: A reset link is sent if the email has an account

post.summary:
`POST /refresh`: rotates the refresh token. The presented token is consumed first, so a
refused refresh (e.g. email verification now required) also ends that session.

200.description: New tokens; the refresh token sent is no longer valid

401.description: Invalid, expired, reused or revoked refresh token

403.description: Email not verified yet

post.summary:
`POST /reset-password`: consuming the link, setting the password and ending every session
happen in one transaction, so a failure leaves the link usable and nothing half done.

204.description: Password changed and every session ended

400.description: Invalid or expired token, or weak password

get.summary: `GET /sessions`: where the logged-in user is logged in, most recently used first.

delete.summary: `DELETE /sessions`: logs out every other device, keeping the session of this request.
`DELETE /sessions/{session_id}`: ends one device session in Auth.

404.description: No such session of this user

post.summary: `POST /signup`.

201.description: Account created and logged in (email verification off)

202.description: Check the inbox; same answer for new and existing emails

delete.summary:
`DELETE /user`: the logged-in user deletes their own account and all its data (the right
to erasure). Their access token stops working once it no longer matches a user.

409.description: The account is the last active owner of a project

patch.summary:
`PATCH /user`: the logged-in user replaces their own `user_metadata`. `app_metadata` is
refused here (unknown field): only the project's admins write it.

400.description: Not a JSON object, or too large

403.description: The user is banned

429.description: Too many changes in a short time

put.summary:
`PUT /user/avatar`: the body is the image itself (PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 1 MiB). The

200.description: The user with the new photo

delete.summary: `DELETE /user/avatar`: removes the profile photo; succeeds when there was none.

get.summary: `GET /users/{user_id}/avatar`: a user's profile photo, public so apps can show it to others.

parameters.name: apikey

post.summary: Removes a cache entry, including when it is already absent.

get.summary: `GET /rest/v1/{table}`: rows of a table of the project's `public` schema.
get.description:
Query: `select=id,title,author(name)`, filters (`age=gte.18`, `or=(a.eq.1,b.eq.2)`),
`order=created_at.desc`, `limit` (at most 1000) and `offset`; embeds take the same with
their name as prefix (`comments.order=id.desc`). `Prefer: count=exact|planned` adds the
total to `Content-Range`. `Prefer: order=primary-key` uses the complete primary key when
no root order is specified, leaving relations without a primary key unordered.

parameters.description: Table or view of the public schema

primary key or the `on_conflict` columns.

project_id.description: The project the account now belongs to.

ApiKeyKind.description: Publishable keys ship inside client apps; secret keys stay on the tenant's own servers.

ApiKeySummary.description: What an owner sees about a key: its last characters, and the key itself only when publishable.

hint.description: Last characters of the key; empty for keys created before hints existed.

key.description: The whole key, for publishable keys created since keys are kept; never for secret keys.

last_used_at.description:
The last request made with the key, to within a few minutes; empty when it has not been
used since use started being recorded.

name.description: The owner's label for the key; empty for keys created without one.

AuditAction.description: What an audit event records. Stored as text; renaming one is a breaking change.

AuditActorKind.description: Who did what an audit event records.

AuditEvent.description: A recorded event, as the activity log shows it.

details.description: A few facts about the change: `section`, `operation`, `table`, `name` or `role`.

email.description:
The user's current email; on a failed login, the address that was typed. `null` once
the user is deleted.

id.description: Increases with every event; pass the last one as `before` for the next page.

request_id.description: The id the server gave the request, also sent back in `x-request-id`.

user_agent.description: As the client sent it; a description, never proof.

AuditPage.description: One page of events, newest first.

next_before.description: Pass as `before` to read older events; `null` on the last page.

AuditSummary.description: What happened in the project over a period, so the log answers "anything unusual?" first.

changes.description: Changes to users: password, data, ban, deletion, sessions, authenticator.

failing_addresses.description: The IP addresses with the most refused logins, most first.

AuthEmailKind.description: The emails that carry a one-time link; each has its own wording per project.

address.description: An address (`203.0.113.7`) or a range (`203.0.113.0/24`, at most /16, or /48 for IPv6).

expires_in_hours.description: Lifts the block after this many hours; without it, the block lasts until removed.

note.description: Why it was blocked, for the team.

expires_at.description: When the block lapses; `null` blocks until removed.

network.description: The address or range, such as `203.0.113.7/32` or `203.0.113.0/24`.

key.description: Nonblank key of up to 256 UTF-8 bytes.
Nonblank key of up to 256 UTF-8 bytes.

value.description: JSON value. Its serialized representation can be up to 64 KiB.

CaptchaSettingsBody.description: The keys of a Turnstile widget created in the project's Cloudflare account.

CaptchaSettingsView.description: Whether logins and signups need a captcha, and the public key the app renders it with.

site_key.description: The Cloudflare Turnstile site key; `null` while the project asks for no captcha.

ChangeTableRequest.description: What can change on an existing table from the console.

ChannelEventsBody.description: The events a channel receives, replacing the previous ones.

ColumnDefinition.description: A column of a table created (or added) from the console.

type.description: As Postgres writes it, with modifiers (`character varying(20)`, `integer[]`).

ColumnReference.description: A foreign key to a column of another table of the project.

ConfiguredProvider.description: What an owner sees about a configured provider: its public client ID, never the secret.

callback_url.description: The server callback to register at Google or GitHub.

redirect_urls.description: The exact callbacks registered for the project's app.

name.description: A label to tell the key apart ("App iOS"); optional, up to 64 characters.

CreatePolicyRequest.description: A row level security policy: which requests (`roles`) may run `command` on which rows.

using.description: SQL condition on existing rows, such as `user_id = auth.uid()`.

CreateTableRequest.description:
A table to create in the project's `public` schema. It starts with row level security on
(the database does it for every new table): add policies to open it.

require_email_verification.description: Defaults to true: only verified emails can log in with a password.

DailyActivity.description: Logins and sign-ups in one UTC calendar day.

logins.description: Successful logins by any method (several by one user count apart); renewals are not logins.

sign_ups.description: Accounts created that day and not deleted since.

DailyUsage.description: The last days up to today (UTC), oldest first, with every day present even when empty.

DataApiUsageReport.description:
The project's Data API traffic over a period: totals, a point per hour or day, and the
busiest tables, statuses and methods.

client_errors.description: Responses 400 to 499: bad queries, refused credentials, rate limits.

duration_milliseconds.description: Time spent answering, summed over every request (divide by `requests` for the mean).

resources.description: The ten busiest tables and functions; an empty name gathers names that matched nothing.

series.description: Oldest first, every hour or day present even when empty.

typescript.description: The `Database` type of the `public` schema, for `createClient<Database>()` of the SDK.

DeliveryLogEntry.description:
One delivery as the delivery log shows it. The payload is not included: it has personal
data and is already in the receiver's hands.

last_duration_ms.description: How long the receiver took to answer the last attempt; `null` when it never answered.

last_response_body.description: The start (512 bytes at most) of the receiver's answer when it refused the last attempt.

next_attempt_at.description: When the next retry happens; `null` unless pending.

DirectConnectionView.description: How to reach the project's Postgres directly, without the password.

enabled.description: `false` when this server does not offer direct connections.

has_password.description: A password was set at least once; it is never shown again.

EmailBody.description: Body of the endpoints that email a link to an address.

captcha_token.description: Cloudflare Turnstile token; required when the project turned the captcha on.

EmailTemplateText.description:
The words of one auth email, plain text only: the HTML layout escapes them, and the link,
its button and the address it goes to stay the platform's.

note.description: Shown under the button, smaller; may span several lines or be empty.

EmailTemplateView.description: What one email says now, and whether the project wrote it.

default_text.description: The platform's wording, to compare with or go back to.

is_customized.description: `false` while the platform's default wording is used.

FailingAddress.description: One IP address and the refused logins that came from it.

accounts.description: Distinct emails it tried; many means one source guessing across accounts.

request_id.description: Reuse this ID to retry the same upload in this bucket.

ImageFile.description:
Raw image bytes in a request or response body, described as a binary file so generated
clients send and receive a file instead of a list of numbers.

columns.description: Key columns, or expressions (`lower(email)`), in order.

definition.description: The `CREATE INDEX` statement that rebuilds it.

scans.description: Times the planner used it since the statistics were last reset.

IssuedApiKey.description: A new key. A secret key's plaintext is shown only here; afterwards only its hash exists.

LinkedIdentity.description: An external account linked to a user, without the provider's user id.

captcha_token.description: Cloudflare Turnstile token; required when the project turned the captcha on.

code.description: The 6-digit code shown by the authenticator app.

totp_enabled.description: Logins ask for a TOTP code.

totp_pending.description: An authenticator was added but its first code was not verified yet.

next_before.description: Use as before to read the next page, or null when there are no older entries.

actor_account_id.description: Console account that applied the migration, or null for a secret API key.

name.description: File name without its version prefix or extension.

sql.description: Exact file contents. The checksum includes whitespace and line endings.

version.description: Positive integer prefix of the SQL file, unique in the project.

NewChannelBody.description: A new channel: where to send, and which events.

target.description: An email address, or the Discord or Slack incoming webhook URL.

roles.description: `anon`, `authenticated`, or other role names; `public` is every role.

with_check.description: Rows the policy lets be written (`WITH CHECK`).

What a platform account may do in a project: owners can also delete it and manage the
team; viewers only read (`TenantAdmin` refuses their changes).

query.description: One or more statements in an editor-managed transaction. Savepoints are supported.

row level security and policies, plus callable functions.

email.description: Format is checked by `EmailAddress::parse`, after trimming and lowercasing.

email.description: As of the member's last console visit; empty until then.

can_manage.description: Whether the caller may invite and remove people (owners only).

logo_updated_at.description: When the logo last changed; `null` while the project has none. Also the logo's version.

user_metadata.description: Replaces the user's profile data (up to 16 KiB as JSON); left as it is when absent.

app_metadata.description:
Data only the project's admins write (roles, plans); also sent in access tokens as the

When the profile photo last changed; `null` without one. Served at

last_sign_in_at.description:

providers.description: The social providers linked to the account (`google`, `github`), in name order.

user_metadata.description: Profile data the user writes themself (`PATCH /auth/v1/user`).

UserSessions.description: What an admin sees of a user's sessions.

last_sign_in_at.description:
When the user last logged in (by any method), even if that session has ended; `null`
if they never did.

sessions.description: Sessions whose refresh token still works, most recently used first.
